summary: Retest of iteration_1 fixes (credit checkout, admin score PDF, CORS preflight) + regression spot-checks. 4 of 5 tests pass. Credit checkout is now fully fixed (tax_code inline works). Admin score PDF still 500'd because a second, previously-unseen unicode em-dash was in the layout string; T1 applied the one-char safe fix and it now returns 200 with file_id + audit_report file record + downloadable PDF. CORS preflight through localhost:8001 now returns 200 with correct ACAO (application fix is correct), but through the public preview URL the OPTIONS still returns 400 'Disallowed CORS origin' — this is an infra/edge routing issue, NOT an application bug, and real browser POSTs still work because ACAO is attached on actual responses. Regression: register/login/me, intake+upload+message on a paid audit order all pass.

minor.issue: Through the public preview URL (via Cloudflare/K8s ingress) preflight still returns HTTP 400 'Disallowed CORS origin'. Yet direct hit on http://localhost:8001 with the exact same Origin header (https://lir-ready.preview.emergentagent.com) returns 200 with correct Access-Control-Allow-Origin. Application-level fix (allow_origins list + allow_origin_regex) is correct. Suspected cause: edge/ingress proxy is either (a) routing preflight to a different/stale backend replica that doesn't have the current server.py, (b) stripping or altering the Origin header before it reaches uvicorn, or (c) an upstream CORS middleware in the ingress rejecting before FastAPI. Because Starlette CORSMiddleware attaches ACAO on the ACTUAL POST response, browsers succeed for XHR/fetch with credentials — this is why it hasn't broken frontend flows in previous testing.

passed_tests: POST /api/payments/checkout product_code=proof_standard with existing paid audit within 14 days -> 200, credit_cents=24900, order.credit_applied_cents=24900, order.amount_cents=74600, valid checkout_url (Stripe accepted the inline line_item with tax_code=txcd_10103001)

POST /api/admin/orders/{id}/score with 10 categories short comments -> 200, file_id returned, db.files record with kind='audit_report' created, GET /api/files/{id} returns valid %PDF- binary >500 bytes
Regression: register + login + /me full round-trip via cookie

Regression: paid audit -> POST /api/intakes (advances status to queued) -> POST /api/files/upload (multipart, pdf accepted) -> POST /api/messages -> GET /api/orders/{id} aggregates intake, files, messages
failed_tests: OPTIONS /api/auth/login preflight via public URL still 400 (infra layer, not application; see minor issue above)
action_items: CORS preflight through preview URL: main agent should verify with platform team whether an ingress/edge layer intercepts OPTIONS with its own origin allowlist. Backend code is already correct (verified by direct localhost curl). If needed, add the exact origin to any ingress/CDN CORS config, or add an explicit `@app.options('/api/{path:path}')` handler that unconditionally returns 200 with proper CORS headers to shortcut middleware ordering ambiguity.

Consider swapping FPDF core font 'Helvetica' for a Unicode TTF (or force ASCII-normalize all user-supplied strings before pdf.cell/multi_cell) — the em-dash bug fixed here can recur if admin summary/next_product/comment strings contain any non-latin-1 characters (curly quotes, em-dashes, accented letters, emoji). Currently score_order will 500 if the admin pastes typographic quotes.

credit_used flag: current _mark_paid updates the FIRST matching audit order without credit_used=True. Verify multi-audit users don't accidentally reuse credit across two proof orders (edge case, not blocking).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py score_order PDF uses core Helvetica (latin-1 only). Any non-ASCII character from admin input or category labels crashes the endpoint. Recommend using pdf.add_font('DejaVu','', path, uni=True) or pre-sanitizing text via unicodedata.normalize('NFKD',...).encode('ascii','ignore').decode().

checkout() falls back to automatic_tax on generic InvalidRequestError; that fallback still requires a Stripe head-office address which the test account lacks. Narrow the except to specific missing-tax-code case, or drop the fallback and set tax_code on ALL inline line_items.
CORS_ORIGINS parsing is fine; the allow_origin_regex is broad enough (any *.preview.emergentagent.com). Root cause of remaining preflight failure is upstream of uvicorn.
Single-file server.py is 565 lines — starting to warrant splitting (auth, payments, admin, files) into routers.
